recognition.prompt: Is it a bit chilly in here?
recognition.reply: I should have brought a jumper.

recognition.prompt: What time do you make it?
recognition.reply: Time to put the kettle on.

murders.title: Have you got the time?
murders.instruction: Ask your chosen person ‘Have you got the time?’ and get an answer. Once they answer, the task is complete.

murders.title: Favourite biscuit
murders.instruction: Ask your chosen person ‘What’s your favourite biscuit?’ and get an answer. Any biscuit counts.

murders.title: Weekend plans
murders.instruction: Ask your chosen person ‘Got much planned for the weekend?’ and let them answer. That completes the task.

murders.title: Could you pass that?
murders.instruction: Ask your chosen person to pass you an ordinary object, such as a pen, napkin or plate. The task is complete when they pass it to you.

murders.title: Weather question
murders.instruction: Ask your chosen person ‘Do you reckon it’ll rain later?’ and get an answer. Keep it casual.

murders.title: Coin in a pocket
murders.instruction: Leave a coin in a pocket of your chosen person’s unattended coat. The coin is a game prop; leave it there until the reveal.

murders.title: Sticky note
murders.instruction: Get a small sticky note reading ‘In Plain Sight’ onto your chosen person’s back, or the back of the chair they are sitting in. Leave it there for at least ten seconds.

murders.title: Say ‘fair enough’
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say ‘fair enough’ during a conversation. You may steer the conversation, but don’t directly ask them to repeat the phrase.
